title: Diffusion Models are Minimax Optimal Distribution Estimators
tldr_zh: Besov 密度+经验 score matching：TV 率 n^{-s/(2s+d)} minimax、W1 率 n^{-(s+1-δ)/(2s+d)} 几乎 minimax；线性子空间数据率只含 d'
tldr_en: With Besov-class densities and empirical score matching, diffusion models achieve minimax TV rate n^{-s/(2s+d)} and almost-minimax W1 rate; subspace data give intrinsic-dimension rates.
key_numbers: E[TV(X0,Ŷ)] ≲ n^{-s/(2s+d)} log^{(5d+8s)/(2d)} n (Thm 5.1); lower bound n^{-s/(2s+d)} (Prop. 5.2)
E[W1(X0,Ŷ)] ≲ n^{-(s+1-δ)/(d+2s)} with switched networks (Thm 5.4); lower bound n^{-(s+1)/(2s+d)} (Prop. 5.3)
Score approximation error ≲ N^{-2s/d} log N / σ_t² with L=O(log⁴N), S=O(N log⁸N) (Thm 3.1)
Generalization: E∫‖ŝ−∇log p_t‖² ≲ n^{-2s/(d+2s)} log^{18} n (Eq. 4)
